birth.segment: Italica and the Ward of Trajan
birth.stop: Rome: the birth of Publius Aelius Hadrianus
birth.date_confidence: Day attested by the Historia Augusta, which dates the birth to the seventh consulship of Vespasian and the fifth of Titus. The place is disputed: the biographer says Rome, most modern accounts say Italica in Baetica, and no source locates the house, so the pin is a neutral point on the Palatine and Forum ground.
